collections.description: The actual producer uploaded, submitted and retrieved assessments through the authenticated evaluator API. Both candidates passed the public compile check. Independent behavior and final-state checks accepted the correct candidate and rejected the plausible incorrect one.
collections.inference: These fixed-candidate controls establish protocol behavior. A separate real-producer snapshot control recovered in a fresh process after a forced crash without another candidate invocation.
